answer: By the echo of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cedar of the next round. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
